description: Add one bookable thing to the company directory. Call get_booking_resources first — a resource is reused across every service, so a second "Marco" would split one barber into two calendars and let him be booked twice at once. The name is what staff will see in the calendar.

kind.description: What sort of thing it is — drives the labels the merchant sees

name.description: As the merchant says it, e.g. "Marco", "Room 101", "Scooter 7"

tag.description: Identifier of this exact instance if it has one: room number, plate, QR, e.g. "SC-07"

name: hub_create_booking_resource
title: Create a booking resource
